title: Building and opening the Moulin Rouge during the war
summary: Speck buys lumber to build the Moulin Rouge; the band plays Chartres Street and wrestling-night dances, and opens the Moulin Rouge.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: That's Lucci. That's his name. Lucci too. They called Lucci, but his right name is Albert. So well, we all played together. So, and after that, well, so Speck wanted us to come back again. So we came back again. And what happened? I tell you what happened. No, he, Speck, what they did Speck during time of the war, see? The fella want to buy this place out, see? And you see, after Speck, after this guy done paid Speck his money back when he put it in the building, you see? He double-crossed it. You see? He sold it place. The fella called Thomas C. Alright, so that made Speck was in the jam during time of the war. We had a lot of money on it then, you see? In the second edition. So, Speck did Speck, went all through the country buying used lumber to build that Moulin Rouge. See? Now we used to play in wrestling on Saturday. And we used to play Chapitula, La Pola and Chapitula, we used to play Wednesday, Friday, Wednesday and Friday. See? And Saturday we'd go to wrestling. And Sunday we'd come back and play on Chapitula Street, you see? That's for white a color on Chapitula? For white. That's white. Right on the corner.
What's the name of that place? I don't know.
I don't know the name of that. They had no house to go. What corner is it there? No, no. Right on the corner. Look. Right on the corner of Chapitula. On that side.
Yeah, on that side, yeah. Going- Downtown Lake Corner.

Yeah. So, all right. So, well, all right. So, well, after that, after Speck had got this dance all completed, he wanted us to play at the Moulin Rouge for him, you see? We opened the Moulin Rouge. So he told Joey, he said, I'd like to get your band to play for me at the Moulin Rouge.
